comment: Well-known ports the Firewall Manager explains in rule summaries and risk findings. localOnly: meant for the local network (Local Subnet is enough). risk: none | low | medium | high when reachable from untrusted networks.

ports.name: SSH
ports.meaning: Secure Shell remote login and file transfer.

ports.name: RPC endpoint mapper
ports.meaning: Finds RPC and DCOM services; used by remote management.

ports.name: NetBIOS name service
ports.meaning: Legacy name lookups on the local network.

ports.name: NetBIOS datagram
ports.meaning: Legacy browsing announcements on the local network.

ports.name: NetBIOS session (SMB over NetBIOS)
ports.meaning: Legacy file sharing transport.

ports.name: SMB file sharing
ports.meaning: Shared folders and printers.

ports.name: SSDP / UPnP discovery
ports.meaning: Finds media devices and routers on the local network.

ports.name: SQL Server
ports.meaning: Microsoft SQL Server database connections.

ports.name: UPnP host
ports.meaning: UPnP device hosting on the local network.

ports.name: Xbox networking
ports.meaning: Xbox Live and many game peers.

ports.name: Remote Desktop
ports.meaning: Remote Desktop connections to this PC.

ports.name: Remote Desktop (UDP)
ports.meaning: Remote Desktop transport over UDP.

ports.name: Teredo
ports.meaning: IPv6 over UDP through NAT, used by Xbox party chat and peer multiplayer.

ports.name: WS-Discovery
ports.meaning: Finds printers and devices on the local network.

ports.name: mDNS
ports.meaning: Multicast name discovery on the local network.

ports.name: LLMNR
ports.meaning: Link-local name lookups (being phased out).

ports.name: WSD events
ports.meaning: Device events for discovered devices.

ports.name: VNC
ports.meaning: VNC remote control.

ports.name: WinRM (HTTP)
ports.meaning: PowerShell remoting.

ports.name: WinRM (HTTPS)
ports.meaning: PowerShell remoting over HTTPS.

ports.name: Delivery Optimization
ports.meaning: Peer-to-peer update sharing.

ports.name: Source engine game server
ports.meaning: Steam/Source game servers and peers.
